key_findings: Nerve injury raises H3K9me2/H3K27me3 at the miR-32-5p promoter, reducing GR binding and miR-32-5p, which de-represses Cav3.2 and drives trigeminal neuropathic pain.
miR-32-5p overexpression reversed mechanical allodynia and lowered Cav3.2 and T-type currents.
